description: FAO Food Price Index monthly values (2002-2004 = 100) from the FAO CSV: overall index plus meat, dairy, cereals, oils and sugar sub-indices, latest months first. The published file currently ends in March 2018, so the tool reports that date rather than a newer month. Related tools on this server, for a different need: energy_pulp_paper_risi_index when you need US producer price index for wood pulp, monthly index value; logistics_jet_a1_fuel_index when you need Daily US Gulf Coast kerosene-type jet fuel spot price. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: energy_fao_food_price_index
title: FAO Food Price Index monthly values from the FAO CSV
